description: T09 (design guidelines §8, exhaustion shading): a unit that has acted this phase goes dim - its board tokens modulate to Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1) with TokenVisual.is_exhausted_this_phase, its roster card (LeftRoster strip, T37) swaps to a darker stylebox with the same modulate - until the phase ends. The phases decide who has acted (BasePhase.has_unit_acted_this_phase: Movement = flags.moved of the active player's units) and emit BasePhase.unit_acted_in_phase(unit_id) on the flip; UnitExhaustionTracker (/root/Main/UnitExhaustionTracker) re-syncs tokens and cards. Fixture audit_baseline_postdeploy, P1 Movement phase. Player path: the Roster button shows the strip; clicking the Blade Champion starts its Normal Move, a real drag moves it 3", and END_UNIT_MOVE (CONFIRM_UNIT_MOVE, the action behind End This Unit's Move) succeeds - the tracker receives unit_acted_in_phase(U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A) once. Tier A: the acted token's modulate is (0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1) within 0.02 per channel and is_exhausted_this_phase; every un-acted token is (1, 1, 1, 1) and not exhausted (24 of 25 tokens; a unit in the middle of its move is not exhausted either). The Shield-Captain is then moved and ended through the real End This Unit's Move button: it dims too, the Custodian Guard row stays lit. The roster mirrors the board (two dim cards, the rest default). Main._recreate_unit_visuals() rebuilds the board: the new tokens start dim. On the dimmed frame the T08 rings read 0.6 x their colours and stay far apart. The phase is ended with the End Movement Phase button + its confirm prompt: in the Shooting phase every token and card is back to (1, 1, 1, 1) / the default look. pixel_diff T09_exhausted -> T09_after: acted_token > 15% (measured 80.5%; the auto-selected shooter (the Telemon) draws a range line over 2.6% of that region in T09_after - 80.0% without those pixels), acted_token_ui > 15% (80.4%), unacted_token < 1% (0.0%, control); T09_before -> T09_exhausted unacted_token < 1% (0.0%); roster cards: acted > 15% both ways (100%), un-acted < 1% (0.0%).
